warnings: These are five precast-plank (SP) bearing/edge-condition types, each a small 1:20 elevation detail rather than a plan-position table -- same treatment as house 02's S1/SX/S0 precedent (topping_mesh + edge dims + note), not the §9 dowel_bar/topping_thickness_min_mm shape verbatim, since the printed content here is bearing length + local reinforcement rather than a generic plank cross-section.

S1 vs S3's exact dowel-spacing callouts (ø9มม@0.20/0.25/0.40 in slightly different combinations) were genuinely difficult to fully disambiguate at this scan resolution -- the bearing lengths (0.50m each side, per §schedule note 'ไม่น้อยกว่า 0.05ม') and general Ø9mm dowel size are confident; the precise per-type spacing digit is lower confidence and may need a re-zoom to fully separate S1 from S3.
S2 (a simple cantilever/edge condition, min width = half the beam width) has no rebar-size callout printed -- it is purely a bearing-geometry rule, recorded as description only.

ST is the slab condition where the finished floor level sits BELOW the beam top (ระดับสูงกว่าหลังคาน per the S-16 title vs. the drawn 'ระยะตามแบบสถาปัตย์' step) -- an angled haunch detail with its own Ø9mm/Ø6mm reinforcement; matches the ST slab-step markers seen on the S-03 floor plan (ramp/laundry step conditions).
SX is the interior-corner/T-junction bearing condition (両 beams meeting), Ø6mm@0.20/0.10 reinforcement.
